family_reports.body: I’ve lost precious time with my children because I was forced to pay a stranger to pretend she knows what’s best for my children. The judge clearly doesn’t know the constitution and continues to violate the rights of families everyday. Mary and Bonfiglio ruined their own reputations by the corruption they’ve created.

This system tore my family apart with false accusations, ignored evidence, and let an absent parent take my child without protection or due process. It has cost us years of lost time, emotional damage, and a bond I’ve fought every day to rebuild.
Judge Bonfiglio and GAL Mary Raatz belong in jail. There are hundreds of us demanding these people are deeply investigated and we won’t stop until they are.
It has caused me to miss out on every milestone my children have had. They have missed out on their baby brothers life.

This system has torn my family apart through years of exhausting court battles, inconsistent visitation, and decisions that made me feel unheard as a mother while my child lost precious time with family who loves him. Despite everything, I’ve continued fighting to stay present, protect my children, and hold onto hope that one day fairness and healing will come for our family.

public_comments.comment_text: She failed to fulfill her duties as GAL failure to comply with GAL guidelines. Told a judge in open court i was being "petty" due to stating safety concerns as cause for objection to her reccomendations for expanded visits. She never even met my child never spoke to care providers made reccomendations that created interference with the standing and still active protective order against my ex husband granted by Judge Bonfiglio as part of the plea deal to the felony case against him. Disregarded evidence of threats to harm my child. Would make unnecessary personal jabs at me in reports supposed to be intended to evaluate my ex husband's actions within supervised visits. Never did home inspections, never asked for pictures of anyone's environments. Disregarded claims of my ex husband's attempts at parental alienation and documented patterns of behavioral regression my son displayed as a direct result to the visitation schedule my sons autism has never been considered in reports or reccomendations and in one phone conversation I offered to submit a full diagnostic report to Mary for her report from the lighthouse autism center and said it was not needed only to then file a report stating "i claimed my son had autism but she has yet to have been provided any documents to verify that diagnosis" to which i submitted the full report directly to the court so it was its one admission to the court record. She was "removed" from our case due to supposed retirement yet she is still overseeing cases of other families.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: She is not legally qualified under Indiana law to be a GAL. She didn’t belong to any state GAL/CASA Program, she isn’t an attorney and she isn’t employed by the court. She is self employed. None of her reports contain a signature. Her email is a personal gmail address, her phone is a personal cell phone and payments are to be sent to a PO Box. She has now retired, only after ABC57 investigated her…she belongs in jail.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Never spoke to me only father wrote several reports with no evidence and nothing but hearsay. Threatened by email to remove my child. Did not follow gal guidelines. Spoke only to father and his attorney Len Gullota refused to write updated report with evidence from dcs and teachers and reports

public_comments.comment_text: She had been assigned in 2019. Went thru the initial hearing and backed me. After took and refilled she absolutely refused to acknowledge anything I said and had proof of. Used the whole Dcs case against me that I actually won and had dismissed.
